notes: the text gives no saying of its own: the chain ends at the Prophet, who is not a link, and the matn_start marks where the Prophet's words would begin (approximate)
«قال محمد بن رافع وأخبرنا محمد بن بشر أخبرنا علي بن نزار عن نزار عن عكرمة عن ابن عباس» is a second isnad written after the chain (rule 9); its names are not links here
